Name: Cloudcutter
Author: duijiangyaoyue
Description:
Cloudcutter is a bamboo-cored blade that grows with every monster you kill — and then keeps growing.
It arrives on the first day in a handwritten letter, starts modest at 10–15 damage, and sharpens along a smooth curve until it outclasses the strongest blade in your game. At 250 kills it learns to drink; at 500 it learns to cut the clouds; at 1000 it is complete.
But the end of the kill counter is only the beginning.
Forge it further
The Cloudforge is a craftable early-game furniture (copper ore, stone, coal) that opens the same menu as the F shortcut.
Six rarity colours: white ×0.8, green ×1.0, blue ×1.25, purple ×1.55, orange ×1.9, red ×2.5.
Ten enhancement levels: +2% damage each, paid with iron, gold, iridium or a prismatic shard.
Ten affixes: Sharp, Swift, Lethal, Heavy, Legendary, Ruin, Warding, Gale, Fury, Craft.
Rarity and affix are rolled independently, so any colour can carry any affix.
Rerolling costs any one of: copper ×10, iron ×7, gold ×5, iridium ×3, or a prismatic shard.
Rarity-coloured particles follow the blade.
Fight with it
15 skills across three categories, unlocked by skill books and equipped in a dedicated loadout menu (G).
5 passive: Frost Edge, Hunter, Snowstep, Blooddrink, Warding.
5 active (right click): Skycleave, Frost Ring, Guard, Shadowstep, Reel.
5 awakening (R): Frostfall, Silver Tide, Thousand Blades, Absolute Zero, Final Oath.
Skill books drop from monsters in the mines and Skull Cavern at 3% per kill.
Five pools, each containing one passive, one active and one awakening book; normal mine depth selects the pool, Skull Cavern has its own.
Books stack, can drop repeatedly, unlock on right-click, and sell for 800g.
Also included
Cloud Slash, Sword Heart, Death Ward, per-tier speed / knockback / crit growth, and a live stat card showing tier, kills, damage, rarity, enhancement and affix.
Compatibility
SVE / RSV aware: final tier scales to 120–180 or 300–375 automatically.
No vanilla weapons are edited; safe to add to an existing save.
Requirements: Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.0+. Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu.
Also, try my mod "The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades," which adds a complete set of character art and dialogue systems to Cloudcutter. The nexusmods end in "54520"
[b]裁云是一把随杀怪数成长的竹骨长刃，而且它的成长远不止于此。[/b]
第一日，一封手书送到农舍邮箱。初到手时它只有 10–15 伤害，并不起眼；但你握着它斩落的每一头怪物，都会让刃上多一分锋芒。二百五十斩，刃生嗜血之性；五百斩，可引云气为刃；千斩之后，裁云大成，云开见日。
而千斩，只是开始。
继续锻造
云纹锻台是可制作的前期家具（铜矿、石头、煤），摆放后手持裁云交互，或直接按 F。
·        六色品阶：白 ×0.8、绿 ×1.0、蓝 ×1.25、紫 ×1.55、橙 ×1.9、红 ×2.5。
·        十级强化：每级 +2% 伤害，消耗铁锭、金锭、铱锭或五彩碎片。
·        十种词缀：锋利、迅捷、致命、重击、传奇、破军、守护、疾风、狂怒、天工。
·        品阶与词缀独立随机，任何颜色都可能带任何词缀。
·        洗词缀材料任选其一：铜锭 ×10 / 铁锭 ×7 / 金锭 ×5 / 铱锭 ×3 / 五彩碎片 ×1。
·        品阶会飘出对应颜色的粒子。
带上它战斗
15 个技能，分三类，靠技能书解锁，在专属装配界面（G）里选择。
·        5 个被动：霜刃、猎手、踏雪、饮血、守御。
·        5 个主动（右键）：裂空、霜环、守势、影步、回锋。
·        5 个觉醒（R）：霜落、银潮、千刃、绝对零度、终誓。
·        技能书由矿洞与骷髅洞穴的怪物掉落，每次击杀 3%。
·        共 5 个掉落池，每池包含 1 本被动、1 本主动、1 本觉醒；普通矿洞按层数选池，骷髅洞穴单独一池。
·        技能书可堆叠、可重复掉落，右键使用解锁，售价 800 金。
其他
裁云斩、剑心、替死、每阶攻速/击退/暴击成长，以及实时显示阶数、击杀、伤害、品阶、强化与词缀的属性卡。
兼容性
·        SVE / RSV：终阶自动适配 120–180 / 300–375。
·        不改动任何原版武器，可安全加入现有存档。
也请尝试一下我的mod“ 灵兵契-万刃物语 ”，该mod为裁云添加了一整套立绘与对话系统，N网尾号为“54520”
